newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech MP Wagner says 1997 budget should move ahead.
newsitem.headline: Czech MP Wagner says 1997 budget should move ahead.

text.p: Czech budget committee chairman Jozef Wagner on Tuesday told the lower house of parliament he would recommend that the 1997 draft budget be allowed to move to the next step in the legislative process.
"I recommended that the chamber send the proposal to a second reading," Wagner, a member of the opposition Social Democrats said, despite giving a long speech lambasting the centre-right government.
The budget is expected to have its first reading later this week, during which major principles will to be debated. Only minor changes can be made in later readings.
